The [[City/Legends|city]] of '''Netassa''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]] and the site of an Imperial outpost during years before and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
